products.summary: A foaming TPU that prints lighter and softer the hotter you run it, from 93A down to 77A. At $38.65 per kg it was the lowest per-kg price among the foaming TPUs we checked.
products.fit: Lightweight flexible parts that must hold their shape, such as cosplay armor, RC plane and drone bumpers, and protective covers, when cost per kg matters.
caveats: Its softest setting is 77A. For insole-soft parts near 65A, Siraya Tech Flex TPU Air 85A and colorFabb varioShore go softer.
Stringing is unavoidable. eSUN says to turn retraction off and print one model at a time.
eSUN advises against the Bambu Lab AMS. Feed it from an external spool or dry box through a short guide tube.
Owners on the Bambu Lab forum disagree on settings: one printed well at about 0.5-0.6 flow and 491-500 °F (255-260 °C), while another said no profile printed well.
The store showed 24 in stock on 2026-11-14 at a flash-sale price. The usual price is $32.99.
Shipping is $5.99 and free on orders over $129. Choose the US region on the store before you order, because it does not ship across regions.

notes:
HOW THE QUERY WAS CHOSEN: I tested five eSUN angles and dropped four. (1) LW-PLA for RC planes: Bambu PLA Aero was $26.99/1 kg on Bambu's US store on 2026-11-14 (sale; usual price $44.99), below eSUN PLA-LW at $28.99, and colorFabb LW-PLA foams lighter. eSUN wins no segment, so PLA-LW is a product record only. (2) 3 kg/5 kg PLA spools: SUNLU PLA+ 5 kg listed at $54.99 against eSUN's $68.99 (SUNLU price from search, not verified). (3) Bulk PETG: Kingroon, Anycubic and Elegoo reported at $8-10/kg against eSUN's $9.99/kg, so no clear win. (4) ESD filament: eSUN PETG-ESD and ABS-ESD showed 0 in stock in the US. (5) Foaming TPU: chosen. Few pages answer it beyond store listings and forum threads, and eSUN TPU-LW honestly wins on firmness (93A top end) and price per kg.

PAIN POINTS (counted across the sources I read): stringing/oozing because retraction fails with foaming material, 8 (CNC Kitchen; 2 Bambu forum threads with 3 users; eSUN spec page; QIDI page; Polyfab listing; Siraya blog snippet; colorFabb guide); tuning temperature and flow per hardness, 4; moisture and drying, 5; feeding/AMS/buckling, 3; price, 2 (eSUN cheaper than colorFabb, from the forum).

SEGMENTS AND WINNERS: soft parts at 65-70A (insoles, grips): Siraya Tech Flex TPU Air 85A, from $42.99 per 1 kg, US warehouse, 103 in stock. It is not an approved program, so it is named without a link. Firm lightweight parts and lowest per-kg price: eSUN TPU-LW, $28.99 per 0.75 kg = $38.65/kg, 93A to 77A. Proven settings and independent data: colorFabb varioShore 95A, $59.70 per 0.7 kg = $85.29/kg, measured 92A to 65A by CNC Kitchen.

VERIFICATION: The eSUN store returns 403 to storecheck.py and to WebFetch, and storecheck found no products.json, so it is likely not a standard Shopify store. I read each eSUN page through the r.jina.ai reader mirror on 2026-11-14: TPU-LW from $28.99 (was $32.99), US 24 in stock, colors White/Black/Grey; PLA-LW from $28.99 (was $36.99), US 29 in stock; PLA+ 1 kg $16.99 (was $22.99), US 1715 in stock, 49 colors. The store shows only 'from' prices, so I could not read per-color prices. The SAVE-22, SAVE-12 and save-6 codes were printed on the eVacuum Kit Pro product page. That page also said 'Can not deliver to United States' for that kit, and the TPU-LW page showed no codes, so whether the codes apply storewide is unverified and needs a cart test. Siraya price: storecheck gave $42.99 and a WebFetch read gave $43.99 sale, likely different variants, so the page says 'from $42.99'. QIDI TPU-Aero is $45.99 via storecheck search; the net spool weight is not stated, so no per-kg price is given. colorFabb US prices are the 'from' prices on its category listing.

UNVERIFIED, KEPT OFF THE PAGE OR MARKED: eSUN's 77A floor and Siraya's and QIDI's 65A floors are maker claims, not independent tests. eSUN's foaming ratio is 172% on the store and 200% on its spec page (both shown in the record). eSUN's filament density (1.15 g/cm³) is marked 'to be confirmed' on its own page, so I left it out. Recreus Filaflex Foamy is left out because I found no US maker store. No Amazon records, per the temporary rule. I had no hands-on owner reviews of eSUN TPU-LW beyond the Bambu forum thread, which has 2 reports.
